subject.title: docs: add agent runtime boundary documentation

question: Should the host-specific Codex teardown and cleanup procedure become a supported public OpenClaw documentation contract, or should this page cover only the generic managed-runtime boundary?
rationale: Current source supports the Gateway health and inventory commands, but the wrapper names, container entrypoint, credential-removal procedure, and cleanup cadence come from one host-maintenance event rather than an established general product contract.

options.title: Narrow the public page
options.body: Keep generic product-backed guidance and move the host-specific teardown procedure to private operator documentation.

options.title: Adopt the full runbook
options.body: Publish the complete procedure after Gateway/security ownership confirms it as supported policy and the checklist proves agent startup.

options.title: Keep it entirely internal
options.body: Close the public documentation proposal and retain the maintenance procedure only in private operator documentation.

recommendation.title: Narrow the public page
recommendation.body: Keep generic product-backed guidance and move the host-specific teardown procedure to private operator documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history signal spans the affected Gateway security, runtime architecture, CLI, and navigation surfaces.
